title: US girl starts selling slime to pay for school trip, gets 8 million views in a month
summary_full: A 14-year-old Indiana girl who started selling slime and squishy toys to fund a school trip to Washington, DC, has attracted over eight million online views. Lexi Long launched her business, Slime & Squish, on October 1 and reached her fundraising goal within nine days. Her business has since gained more than 30,000 social media followers and attracted customers at local events and shops.
